author: Myv
body:
NOTE: I am not happy with the mid, it is unfinished to me by miles.

Hello, I am here to present my 11th project, and my first attempt at a DTC/DTM combined.

It is called Vicus, which has nothing to do with Avicus, rather the fact that it is Latin for 'Quartz'.

Map Information

Team Colours: Red and Blue
Team Sizes: 20v20?
To be destroyed: 1 emerald core with 20 blocks, and 2 obsidian monuments.
Kit: Iron Sword, Leather Armour (coloured, full armour), 4 gapples, 64 glass, 64 wood, Infinity bow, 64 Steak, 1 arrow.
Time Limit: Whatever is needed for DTC.

Other

Download: Not yet
XML: Not yet.

Album: http://imgur.com/a/uBZ8D

Thanks for taking the time to look at my map and I appreciate all feedback.

Myv
